government_warning.heading: GOVERNMENT WARNING:
government_warning.body: (1) According to the Surgeon General, women should not consume alcoholic beverages during pregnancy because of the risk of birth defects. (2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages may impair your ability to drive a car or operate machinery, and may cause health problems.
